prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production top-down Unity 2D enemy PNG sprite on a genuinely transparent background. The attached dust bunny is ONLY a reference for the established game's soft cartoon art style, not a subject to copy. Match its clean smooth dark plum outlines, matte soft shading, rounded shapes, restrained pastel color palette, friendly mischievous tone, and readable silhouette at 30 to 60 screen pixels. Near-overhead orthographic view with very little visible side, no perspective floor. Center the entire object in a compact roughly square footprint, balanced transparent padding 10 percent on every side, no clipping. No background, no ground shadow, no frame, no text or logos, no drawn checkerboard, no detached particles or extra objects. Actual alpha transparency is essential. Do not draw a sprite sheet, collage or multiple variants. Subject: one small irregular broken bread crumb creature, a compact torn wedge of pale golden bread with a thin warm toasted crust along one edge, a few big simple pores, two tiny mischievous dark eyes and a small mouth. It should clearly read as a bread crumb or small torn bread fragment, not a full toast slice, not a whole loaf, not a pastry, not another fluffy dust bunny. Warm golden ochre against the dark walnut game floor. Simplify details for a tiny fast swarm enemy.
